The '''Evil Raiders''' were a group of space [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] active in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:StERA" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], they allied with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] against the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="SWG:CtWS">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Capture the Weapons Shipment|Dathomir system}}</ref>

In space battles, they flew [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk fighters]], [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]]s and [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]]s.<ref name="SWG:DtERT">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Destroy the Evil Raider Tyrant|Endor system}}</ref>
